create_container_insight: create a ContainerInsight dataclass instance with time, cluster_name, instance_id, status, and optional exit_code fields
review_container_insight: review the ContainerInsight dataclass that extends Insight with container-specific fields like cluster_name and exit_code
summarize_container_insight: summarize the ContainerInsight dataclass used to represent container runtime insight data with status and exit code
build_container_insight_json: build a JSON representation of a ContainerInsight instance using the inherited to_dict and convert_to_str_with_class_name methods
test_container_insight: test the ContainerInsight dataclass by instantiating it with required fields and verifying serialization via the Insight parent class
